$comment: THE hand-written part. Four packages -- ui, js, php, py -- are generated from this directory and are never edited. Every API fact here is read from Google's YouTube v3 discovery document (https://youtube.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v3).
title: YouTube

oauth.$scopeComment: playlistItems.insert accepts youtube, youtube.force-ssl and youtubepartner. youtube.force-ssl is narrower than full `Manage your YouTube account` access while still allowing edits to videos and related channel resources, so it is the least authority this action needs; youtubepartner is for content partners.
oauth.$comment: The host performs the browser consent flow and refreshes Google's one-hour access token; refreshToken is required so the connection does not expire after that hour.

$sandboxComment: CHECKED. YouTube exposes no separate test estate. Adding a test video creates a real playlist item on a real YouTube channel.
sandboxNote: YouTube has no sandbox. Every live-mode add changes a real playlist; use the faker during development and remove live test items afterward.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client ID
credentialFields.help: From Google Cloud Console. One value for the whole installation.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client secret
credentialFields.help: The client secret for the same OAuth app.

credentialFields.label: Access token
credentialFields.help: Per connected YouTube account; expires after one hour.

credentialFields.label: Refresh token
credentialFields.help: Per connected YouTube account; the host uses it to refresh the access token.
